# TelosCode

> A European software engineering studio that builds custom software and AI agents for service businesses — hotels, restaurants, clinics, law firms, and professional services firms.

TelosCode is a small senior team working remotely across Europe and the USA. Engagements are scoped and priced as a fixed investment before build starts, and clients work directly with the engineers designing and building the product rather than through an account layer.

## What TelosCode builds

- Booking systems and guest or client operations platforms
- Client portals and self-service journeys
- AI agents and workflow automation that remove repetitive operational work
- Integrations between CRMs, booking tools, payment systems, and internal platforms
- Internal tools that replace spreadsheet-and-inbox processes

## How engagements work

- Fixed project pricing, agreed before the build begins
- Most focused projects ship in 8 to 16 weeks; larger platforms ship in stages
- Clients own the source code, project, and data from the start
- A 30-day guarantee applies after handover
- Ongoing support and evolution available after launch

## Industries served

Hotels and hospitality, restaurants, law firms, clinics, and professional services.
